_provenance.source: file/var.docx -> word/document.xml -> getFaceLineData() (real, de-minified Crisalix viewer JS bundle)
_provenance.extractionMethod: Programmatic bracket-depth parse of the literal getFaceLineData() return array + regex resolution of each referenced `var IDENT = [...]` vertex-index constant. No manual transcription, no summarization, no index guessed.
_provenance.note_fullScanArea: FaceFullScanAreaId.FOREHEAD/NECK are runtime Symbols, not static index arrays -- NOSE_PROFILE's fullScanArea data (area/border for the full-scan mesh) is resolved at runtime from server-provided data (FreeLineTool#fullScanAreas Map), NOT present as a static constant in this bundle. Marked accordingly below.

NOSE_BRIDGE_VERTICES.usedBy: straightNoseBridgeLineDeformation() -> tool.straightLine(model, NOSE_BRIDGE_VERTICES) -- filters NOSE_PROFILE's own `line` array down to these 15 vertices before straightening

FaceFullScanAreaId.FOREHEAD: Symbol('forehead') -- runtime symbol, no static vertex array in bundle
FaceFullScanAreaId.NECK: Symbol('neck') -- runtime symbol, no static vertex array in bundle
